_source: 203 candidates measured against this library on 2026-09-27 (docs/qa-catalog.md, AG): every track with no words whose lrclib entry was more than 3 s from the file, aligned to the file to see whether the words and the timings belong to it.
_note: span is how much of the singing the entry's stamps cover, unplaced the share of lines the aligner would not place. These two numbers are the whole of the decision, so the recorded measurements are the fixture: no model runs in the tests. Each row also carries the album and the lrclib entry id, so a slow end-to-end run can find the track in a library by artist, title and album. No filesystem path is recorded here on purpose: this repository is public.
